label: Kelly Trogdon, Grounding PDF p. 2…: If a fact is fully grounded in a plurality of facts, the…
locator: PDF p. 2 (printed p.466), introduction distinction (i)–(iii) and necessity
interpretation: This is Trogdon's target (iii), not persistence of the grounding claim (i).
attribution: The passage states if a fact is fully grounded in a plurality of facts, the conjunction of the propositions corresponding to those grounds metaphysically necessitates the proposition corresponding to the grounded fact, which is the premise.
